description: Defines the PersistentStore class and related nested classes, interfaces, and methods for a plugin-based persistent storage system within the WPEFramework. Includes notification handling, configuration, and RPC endpoint declarations.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main plugin class managing persistent storage, notifications, and RPC endpoints within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for persistent store parameters such as paths, key, size limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for changes in the IStore2 data, triggers events on value change.

classes.name: PersistentStore::RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection events, triggers deactivation logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service, sets up resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deactivated.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: RPC endpoint to set a value in the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: RPC endpoint to retrieve a value from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: RPC endpoint to delete a key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: RPC endpoint to delete a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaces
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated RPC endpoint to get storage size.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get storage sizes.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: RPC endpoint to set storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Triggers the onValueChanged event when a store value changes.
